parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Ethanoic acid, $\text{CH}_3\text{CO}_2\text{H}$ and trichloroethanoic acid, $\text{CCl}_3\text{CO}_2\text{H}$, are both carboxylic acids. Ethanoic acid can be used to make ethanamide, $\text{CH}_3\text{CONH}_2$.

Place these three compounds in order of acidity, starting with the least acidic. Explain your answer.

least acidic most acidic
